displayTitle: Everyone Loves Their Own Children Best
description: A close English retelling of a Scandinavian folktale in which a snipe’s proud claim about her “prettiest” chicks meets a hunter’s blunt idea of ugliness, landing on a wry proverb about parental bias.
tone: Wry, simple, folktale-like, and gently moral
summary: A hunter and a snipe argue over which chicks are prettiest, revealing that every parent thinks their own are best.
